subject.title: Suppress model fallback notices in rooms

question: Should fallback transition notices remain visible in direct chats while being suppressed in group/channel rooms, or become internal-only on every external messaging surface?
rationale: The linked report asks for internal-only external-channel telemetry, while this PR intentionally retains direct-chat notices and current documentation describes visible operational notices; source inspection cannot determine the permanent privacy and observability policy.

options.title: Suppress rooms only
options.body: Retain private direct-chat observability, suppress shared-room payloads, and emit lifecycle events independently for every session type.

options.title: Internal-only externally
options.body: Suppress fallback banners on all external messaging surfaces while retaining logs, lifecycle events, status output, and WebUI diagnostics.

options.title: Add explicit policy
options.body: Introduce configurable visibility, accepting a new configuration contract and upgrade burden.

recommendation.title: Suppress rooms only
recommendation.body: Retain private direct-chat observability, suppress shared-room payloads, and emit lifecycle events independently for every session type.

likelyOwner.reason: They were directly involved in reviewing and assigning the original fallback-observability feature and are the strongest available owner for the user-facing policy choice.
